stories.title: Have You Seen This? Rider bursts into flames on busy California highway
stories.summary: The California Highway Patrol is reminding drivers to check their blind spots while releasing dash-cam video of a fiery crash on the 110 freeway in October.

stories.title: Vesper Amphitheater finds new home in Vineyard
stories.summary: After residents spoke out about putting a potential 20,000-seat amphitheater at the mouth of Provo Canyon, Vesper announced Thursday the venue is moving to Vineyard.

stories.title: Pete Rose posthumously pardoned by Trump after baseball's career hits leader was reinstated by MLB
stories.summary: President Donald Trump said he had posthumously pardoned Pete Rose more than two years after the baseball star's death and a year after he was reinstated by MLB Commissioner Rob Manfred.

stories.title: Prosecutor declines to charge a police officer who fatally shot a Black man in Wisconsin
stories.summary: A Wisconsin prosecutor is not filing criminal charges against the police officer who shot and killed a 38-year-old Black man, Corey Ruiz, in Madison in July.

stories.title: Hooper man faces 41 felony counts, including 21 for secretly recording children at church
stories.summary: A Hooper man who served as a church teacher faces 41 felony counts, including 21 for secretly recording children and 19 for possession of child sexual abuse material.

stories.title: Cincinnati Zoo says Fiona the hippo has died, days after ingesting a visitor's hat
stories.summary: The Cincinnati Zoo on Thursday said Fiona the hippo died days after ingesting a visitor's hat.

stories.title: North Summit High School teacher charged with sending inappropriate pictures to teen students
stories.summary: A teacher in Summit County arrested and accused of sending inappropriate pictures and messages to teen girls at his school now faces felony charges.

stories.title: From bus driver's seat to classroom: An Alabama teacher impacting students' lives with positivity
stories.summary: Doniell Milliner is a seventh-grade English teacher who also drives a school bus. She calls it the best of both worlds.

stories.title: Church History Museum opens three new exhibits to support Salt Lake Temple Celebration
stories.summary: Three new exhibits are now open at the Church History Museum for The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints highlighting people involved in the Salt Lake Temple, depictions of the temple from around the world and conversion stories.

stories.title: South Korea's top court overturns charges against ex-prime minister for his role in martial law
stories.summary: South Korea's Supreme Court on Thursday overturned the conviction of former Prime Minister Han Duck-soo for aiding President Yoon Suk Yeol's brief imposition of martial law.

stories.title: Riverton water main break impacts 30 homes
stories.summary: A water main broke Thursday morning in Riverton, flooding multiple homes and sending gravel into sewer lines. The water service is expected to be restored at 5 p.m., according to Riverton City Communications Coordinator Nate Slack.

stories.title: Man killed following crash in Davis County
stories.summary: A man died after a crash on I-15 in Davis County, according to the Utah Department of Public Safety. The man, who was not wearing his seatbelt, was ejected from his vehicle.
